description: Where the minimap of TmDiagramEditor renders (DI3, tablet redesign phase 6).

values.name: Auto
values.description: The minimap card renders in the right column on a desktop layout and floats over the canvas corner from tablet down (a floating, tappable navigation card). The default.

values.name: Panel
values.description: Always the collapsible card in the right column, on every layout (the pre-phase-6 desktop presentation).

values.name: Overlay
values.description: Always the floating overlay over the canvas corner, on every layout.

examples.title: Force the floating minimap on a desktop-embedded editor
